Instrument.name: The Transmitting (TX) High Gain Antenna (HGA) for LICIACube
Instrument.description: The TX High Gain Antenna was a 4x8 patch array with a low profile. Its compact design allowed the antenna to be placed on the cubesat structure, providing high directivity and high gain (21.7 dBi). It was the primary LICIACube antenna for downlink transmission, operating in the deep space frequency band allocation (8437 MHz). The turnaround ratio for the LICIACube transponder was 880/749.
